title: 力德科技战略总监：人形机器人核心部件订单激增10倍，量产时代来临
speaker: Angle Jagan

segments.en: Oh, I think the key components like frameless torque motors or the integrated modular joints got to grow much faster than the other parts.
segments.zh: 我认为无框力矩电机、集成模块化关节等核心部件，增速会远超其他部件。

segments.en: For example, as to Lee Shan, last year we shipped over 120,000 units of frameless torque which is a 10X Y-O-Y increase
segments.zh: 以力德为例，去年我们交付了超12万台无框力矩电机，同比增长10倍。

segments.en: and this year the orders we received have already surpassed 1 million units so that's a nearly 10-fold increase.
segments.zh: 今年我们已接到的订单已超100万台，又是近10倍的增长。

segments.en: So I think the orders are transitioning from like smart batch prototype or pilot works to mass production orders, especially for...
segments.zh: 所以我认为订单正从小批量原型或试产，转向量产订单，尤其是……
